article.headline: Anne Hathaway Tears Up as She’s Named a Disney Legend (and Her 2026 Box Office Crosses $2 Billion): ‘I’m One of the Most Insanely Lucky People in the World’
article.summary: Shut up! Oscar winner Anne Hathaway is officially a Disney Legend.
